mapper.sql: id, subject, application_id, conversation_type, status, create_by, create_time
mapper.select: select from nad_conversation where application_id = #{applicationId} order by id desc

select from nad_conversation c where c.status = 'OPEN' and not exists ( select 1 from nad_conversation_participant p where p.conversation_id = c.id and p.removed_at is null and p.role = 'STAFF' ) order by c.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into nad_conversation (subject, application_id, conversation_type, status, create_by, create_time) values (#{subject}, #{applicationId}, #{conversationType}, #{status}, #{createBy}, now())
mapper.update: update nad_conversation set status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
